$root.$description: Text in the current color mode. 4.5:1.

default.$description: Text on white, gray, and gold surfaces.

supporting.$description: Supporting text in the current color mode. 4.5:1.

detail.$description: Detail text, such as labels and counts, in the current color mode. 4.5:1.

disabled.$description: Disabled text in both color modes. Exempt from contrast minimums.

background.$description: Fills behind page and section content.

$root.$description: The page in the current color mode.

panel.$description: A panel on the page. In dark mode a panel is black like the page, so give it a hairline.

subtle.$description: A fill one step off the page, in the current color mode.

link.$description: Always underline links. Never rely on blue alone to signal a link.

$root.$description: Link in the current color mode.

default.$description: Link on white and gray surfaces.

gold.$description: Use at full strength, never tinted or translucent. Black text on gold. Never gold text on white or white text on gold. Gold text only for short headlines and callouts on black.

accent.$description: Decorative emphasis. Draw one item out of a set. Do not use accent color to convey status or as the only cue to meaning. Small details only, about 10% of a layout at most. Never against gold, never as text, and never a unit's or campaign's identifying color. Text on an accent fill is black.

categorical.$description: Colors for graphical marks on white or black surfaces, one per categorical series. Assign token 1 to the first series, token 2 to the second, and continue in numerical order without skipping or reordering. Use labels or patterns so color is not the only cue. Categories only: use accent for emphasis elsewhere in a layout and the status colors for status. Never use gold as a category. Text inside a fill is black. Around seven categories, change the structure instead of adding colors.

default.$description: Border on white, gray, and gold surfaces.

strong.$description: Dark border for controls on white and gray surfaces.

strong-inverse.$description: Light border for controls on black surfaces or with black fills.

field.$description: Form field borders in the current color mode. 3:1.

indicator.$description: Current-page bars, check marks, and functional icons, in the current color mode. 3:1.

divider.$description: Lines between sections, in the current color mode. Decoration.

hairline.$description: Thin rules, such as a panel's edge, in the current color mode. Decoration.

info.$description: Informational status. Never decoration. Always pair with text or an icon.

success.$description: Success status. Never decoration. Always pair with text or an icon.

warning.$description: Warning status. Never decoration. Always pair with text or an icon.

danger.$description: Error status. Never decoration. Always pair with text or an icon.

info-surface.$description: Fill behind an info message. Pair with info as the border.

success-surface.$description: Fill behind a success message. Pair with success as the border.

warning-surface.$description: Fill behind a warning message. Pair with warning as the border.

danger-surface.$description: Fill behind an error message. Pair with danger as the border.
